strapiBlog.title: Here’s A Sneak Peek Into Snagging

data.text:
When a project is ready to be handed over to its homeowners, the developer will contact them to schedule an “Orientation” to show them the property and its features. This is the right time for a Snagging Inspection to take place.

It is when you are allowed to check your property and point out any defects or ‘snags’, whether they are cosmetics or technical, minor or major. These ideally will be rectified by the developer before the key handover takes place. It is very important to appoint professional qualified engineers to conduct the snagging inspection for your property, and that is exactly what we provide at Provident.

Unfortunately, most developers don’t live up to their standards that they promise before delivering a project to its homeowners. Thus, using professionals helps you take the handover of your property in its ideal condition before you or your tenants move in. This helps save you/tenants the hassle of having laborers around the house rectifying issues that will be found after the move-in.

And it would save you the time it takes to complete the inspection in every detail which might take up to 5 hours, depending on the size of the property. Also, snagging saves you the money that you would have had to spend in the future to rectify any missed defects at the time of Orientation. Finally, it helps you avoid the conflict of interest when the developer’s executives conduct the orientation/snagging for you.

With Provident, you can be rest assured that we will use this time frame of “Orientation” to its full extent and in the best way through our Snagging service. Our qualified Engineers are trained to focus on each aspect of the property. It is also worth mentioning that we have previous experience in the construction fields in Dubai. We do not miss any of the cosmetics, mechanical, electrical or plumbing features.

Our state-of-the-art equipment with the latest technologies helps us find and point out the hidden issues that would creep on you later when the months go by. The professional Snagging software we use helps us make the process much smoother for all parties involved, producing a detailed comprehensive report within the day. And the best part is, we do not have affiliations with any developers, we have our client’s best interest at heart.
